profile.legalName: Waste Management of Alameda County, Inc.
profile.summary: A company that provides trash, garbage, recycling and compost collection services to homes and businesses in Alameda County, California, including Oakland. It is part of WM, a national waste and recycling services company. It also offers dumpster rentals.
